name: Bones in One Stone

levels.entry: A seam of bone in the black pavement: heavy skulls, a pair of long teeth in the upper jaw, nothing like them alive.
A short walk away, three-toed trackways in the same stone, walking toward water that was not there yet.
They are the same rock. Same layer, same hexagons, same weathering.
The teeth replace from the back forward, like the skeleton in the midden and unlike anything in the delta.
Two kinds of animal that share nothing, lying in one stone that formed after both. I can describe the rock and I cannot describe how they came to be in it together.

notes: Ends unresolved: described exactly, explained not at all.
